summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The JPMorgan Small & Mid Cap Enhanced Equity ETF (JMEE) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in extended market equity. The fund is an actively managed portfolio of small- and mid-cap US stocks and REITs. The fund uses a proprietary selection and weighting criteria, aiming to modestly outperform the total return of the S&P 1000 Index. JMEE was launched on May 6, 2022 and is issued by JPMorgan Chase.

holdings.infoBox: JMEE is an equity ETF with a total of 665 individual holdings. The top holdings are JPMorgan Prime Money Market IM stock at 3.58%, Okta, Inc. at 1.02%, nVent Electric at 0.74%, United Therapeutics at 0.70%, and TechnipFMC at 0.63%.
